name: quotum-hub
description: The Quotum hub: stores what agents measure and serves the dashboard of coding-agent subscription limits (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity).
author: Sergey Padurets

scripts.check: devkit-verify && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.lint: eslint --max-warnings 0 eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs vite.config.ts vite.bundle.config.ts vite.demo.config.ts server && eslint --max-warnings 0 ui && eslint --max-warnings 0 demo bench
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.ui-test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.demo.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.demo-ui.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.fix: npm run format && eslint --max-warnings 0 --fix eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs vite.config.ts vite.bundle.config.ts vite.demo.config.ts server && eslint --max-warnings 0 --fix ui && eslint --max-warnings 0 --fix demo bench && npm run format
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && node server/secrets/build-windows.mjs --dist && tsx --test --test-reporter=@docouno/env/node-test-reporter server/test/*.test.ts ui/test/*.test.ts demo/test/*.test.ts bench/test/*.test.ts
scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true});for(const e of fs.readdirSync('dist'))fs.rmSync('dist/'+e,{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && node server/secrets/build-windows.mjs --dist && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && vite build
scripts.dev: npm run build && node --import tsx demo/index.ts
scripts.demo:keys: vite build --config vite.demo.config.ts && node --import tsx demo/keys-server.ts
